dispatch.retry: Read the saved request; use the same kind and byte-equivalent arguments through request(..., retry_failed=True) and run(...). A changed selection is a new reviewed request.
dispatch.credentials: Original private target profile and bearer-file mechanism, outside the portable workspace; no token or cookie is added by this module.

object_hashes: Fields named *_sha256 in deployment/result records select full immutable Store objects. A plan/review/comparison may also contain an embedded sha256 over its body without that field; use the named result pointer, not a substituted embedded hash.

evidence.source: unchanged Store upload descriptor containing sha256 and filename
evidence.title: optional exact display title

import_exceptions.evidence_sha256: one selected evidence object's raw-byte SHA256
import_exceptions.coordinate: original row/path/cell or supplied coordinate object
import_exceptions.original: complete original row/value, retained without reinterpretation

parameters.import_settings: supplied original object; kept distinct from native observations
parameters.label: optional readable project label

adopt_existing.effects: Pins complete intake and original request before native GETs. Original MsPlannerReader capture plus complete project-team GET pages. No native POST or synthetic completion.

row_ids.tasks: source task key -> actual project-task GUID
row_ids.resources: source resource key -> actual project-team GUID
row_ids.assignments: source assignment key -> actual assignment GUID
row_ids.dependencies: source dependency key -> actual dependency GUID

exception_decisions.exception_id: every original import exception ID, exactly once
exception_decisions.evidence_sha256: list of selected retained evidence hashes; required nonempty for observed_resolved

prepare_adoption_review.effects: Local proposal only; does not revise deployment or call provider. Source keys and GUIDs must belong to the exact retained source/capture. Partial maps remain explicit findings; maps must be injective.

result.import_exception_review: full original exceptions plus authored decisions

review_adoption.effects: Verifies proposal against the current deployment snapshot and inventory, saves original native review plus exact import/identity/capture selections, retains prior adoption plans/reviews.

parameters.edition_id: optional exact source edition, defaults to parent's retained edition; unchanged source is supported
parameters.mappings: optional selected task conversion overrides, same shape as adoption review

prepare_observed_correction.effects: Creates a separately retained child request/plan with an immutable full parent snapshot. Pins selection before GETs. Each first complete actual task GET is retained; reentry reuses it. Only existing msdyn_projecttask fields can produce PssUpdateV1 operations.

result.preparation_records: native GUID -> immutable original GET object

rebind_imported_target.effects: Creates a new reviewed adoption entry under the selected private profile, preserving old principal, parent snapshot, requests, captures and source. Actual WhoAmI must still identify the same organization, and the selected project is unchanged. Fresh complete capture and explicit identity/exception review are required.

result.rebind_sha256: full authored rebind and original identity

commissioning_handover.effects: Requires the original accepted deployment via maintained handover. Emits source/intent/observed/exception/lineage HTML and JSON alongside original handover; no provider call.

result.commissioning_json: original Store artifact descriptor + filename imported-plan-commissioning.json
result.commissioning_html: original Store artifact descriptor + filename imported-plan-commissioning.html
result.lineage_deployment_ids: exact selected chain; ancestors read from pinned snapshots

review.purpose: Review the separately prepared correction through original native review_schedule

continue.purpose: Execute only a reviewed correction with original OperationSets/receipts and uncertain-outcome recovery
continue.adoption: explicitly rejected; imported-plan adoption has no native creation/execute calls

capture_target.purpose: Fresh native capture after actual completed correction, or recapture adopted plan
capture_target.evidence: Full actual pages + native reader identities + intended/observed field values; no atomic multi-page snapshot claim
capture_target.continuation: While capture_in_progress names an original request, a different request is rejected before any capture/progress write or native read. Resume the original request with its original saved arguments; completed requests retain their own readback.

accept.purpose: Record human acceptance of the exact original comparison and current additional evidence

requirements.accepted_commissioning_fields: exact IDs of every non-equal intended/observed field
requirements.exceptions: original readable retained-difference notes; distinct from complete import exception rows

archive.purpose: Original complete PortfolioWorkspace export retains source/native editions, operator objects, responses, plans, reviews, histories and import evidence

receive.purpose: Original PortfolioWorkspace.receive_workspace and TargetWorkspace reopen; private credentials selected on receiving host

inventory.bucket_observations: one complete per-task presence/value observation; no single-bucket assumption
inventory.team_capture_sha256: complete extra native team page journal

correction_plan.operations: original PssUpdateV1 payload plus exact typed before values, native record SHA, observed ETag, conversions and current/capture comparison
correction_plan.correction_basis: original source vs pinned capture remains complete
correction_plan.native_before: full first complete native task GETs
correction_plan.already_current: fields omitted from writes because currently correct
correction_plan.limitations: No task creation, hierarchy/resource/assignment/dependency/calculated-field rewrite; no native atomic If-Match scheduling claim

source_exercise.environment: Run in the existing operator source; Python standard library only for this local exercise, with no provider or native-reader call.
source_exercise.basis: Explicitly authored source/native rows. Real installed receiving remains the original B9D2 programme.
